canonical.title: A Stavanger weekend, anchored on RE-NAA

children.title: Things to do in Stavanger
children.summary: A two-to-three day Stavanger plan around a Michelin-starred dinner: the headline hike, an old-town walking loop, the museum and street-art picks worth the time, and where to eat the rest of the weekend.

children.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Stavanger
children.summary: Stavanger has exactly one restaurant at 2-stars-or-above: RE-NAA, the city's only 3-star. There are zero 2-star options — the next 2-star in Norway is Kontrast in Oslo.

children.title: IT conferences and tech events in Stavanger
children.summary: Calendar of Stavanger's 2026 tech and IT conferences plus the year-round meetup scene — Hello Stavanger, ONS, HealthTech Festival, and what to pair with a weekend trip.
